note: twin values are what the SOUND lane BELIEVES, never what it proved. SILENT-2 confirms on pixels. NONE means this lane could find nothing visual and it is the strongest candidate for a twin.

STING:done.label: (sting) THE JOB IS FINISHED
STING:done.why: carries the moment whose SFX died 10 for 10 -- the coordinator's `done_ring`.

STING:missed.label: (sting) THE JOB WENT UNFINISHED
STING:missed.why: the quietest failure in the game. Nothing announces that the day ended with the work undone -- he just wakes up on day two. This is a real gap and it is not on the coordinator's list because the sting system is not in the rack they swept.

STING:paid.label: (sting) YOU WERE PAID
STING:paid.why: the purse is a number on a screen; this is likely already covered.

STING:taken.label: (sting) YOU TOOK THE JOB
STING:taken.twin: SUSPECTED (an objective arrives on screen -- measured 8/25 on the real walk)
STING:taken.why: the commitment. The objective line appearing IS a twin, and a good one.

block.label: BLOCKED
block.why: the difference between a hit and a blocked hit is the difference between a working plan and a wasted beat.

dry_fire.why: in a rhythm fight, pressing and getting nothing is a beat lost and a chain broken. He has to know it was EMPTY rather than mistimed, and those two failures feel identical without the sound.

phone_buzz.why: the coordinator is right that this is a message and right that the badge is weak, and sweep 14 already found the badge is the ONLY other pointer at the day's work. save_chime.label: SAVED
save_chime.why: the strongest case in the game. Nothing anywhere says a save happened; the chime is the entire notification. A player who cannot hear it has no way at all to know his run is safe, which is exactly the thing a person checks before putting the phone down.

ui_deny.label: YOU CANNOT DO THAT
ui_deny.why: a refusal with no sound is indistinguishable from a BROKEN BUTTON. This is the one on the list that does not just lose information, it actively teaches the wrong thing: he taps, nothing happens, and the game looks broken rather than strict. His own brief for it is "refused. short and flat, never a buzzer."
